data.name: Commonplace Guns
data.description: While still expensive and tricky to wield, early firearms are readily available. Instead of requiring the Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat, all firearms are martial weapons. Early firearms and their ammunition cost 25%% of the amounts listed in this book, but advanced firearms and their ammunition are still rare and cost the full price to purchase or craft.
